statements.status_notes: CVE-2025-61144: a stack buffer overflow in the tiffcrop tool, in readSeparateStripsIntoBuffer(), when an image has more samples per pixel than tiffcrop supports; the fix bounds the sample loop by MAX_SAMPLES (https://gitlab.com/libtiff/libtiff/-/issues/740). Upstream fixed it in https://gitlab.com/libtiff/libtiff/-/commit/88cf9dbb48f6e172629795ecffae35d5052f68aa (LibTIFF 4.7.1). Debian has not fixed it for trixie and rates it as a crash in a command-line tool with no security impact (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2025-61144). The DHI tiff packages for Debian 13 are rebuilds of Debian's trixie tiff 4.7.0-3+deb13u2 and 4.7.0-3+deb13u3. Every published DHI build, from the first rebuild of 4.7.0-3+deb13u2 on, applies that upstream commit unchanged, and the Debian changelog shipped in the current tiff packages (read for amd64 and arm64) carries a DHI entry that lists CVE-2025-61144 among the backported upstream fixes. The fixed version is therefore the first published DHI tiff build.
